title: New Kochikame Anime Reveals Main Cast, Staff, 2027 Debut in Video
content: A livestream event for Shin Kochira Katsushika-ku Kameari Kōen-mae Hashutsujo (New Kochikame), the new anime based on Osamu Akimoto 's Kochikame manga, revealed the new anime's main cast and staff on Saturday. The event also revealed a promotional video and a visual.
author: ANN

title: 'Shin Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Character Promo, 2027 Debut
content: The special livestream presentation for the new television anime adaptation of Osamu Akimoto 's Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo ( KochiKame ) manga revealed the main cast, staff, a key visual (pictured right), and character promotional video on Saturday.

title: 3 Things You Need to Know for Dragon Ball Super’s New Remake
content: 2026 is one of the biggest years for Dragon Ball fans, as the year kicked off with several exciting announcements. The anime is all set to return with its latest remake this Fall 2026 season. Additionally, the main story will also continue later on with the Galactic Patrol Saga.
author: ComicBook

title: Tokyo Anime Award Festival Ends
content: TAAF launched in 2014 as an independent festival and has had 13 iterations. It was an evolution of the Tokyo Anime Award, which was part of the Tokyo International Anime Fair from 2002-2013. TAAF's X (formerly Twitter ) account and YouTube channel will shut down on September 30.
author: ANN

title: Fans Celebrate Beloved Scooby Doo & Dragon Tales Voice Actor, Dead At 85: “His Voice Will Live On Forever”
content: Voice actor Francisco Resendez, best known his work as the Latin American Spanish voice of Scooby-Doo has died. He was 85. The actor passed away on September 2nd. Details about his death have not yet been shared.

title: 10 Years Later, Crunchyroll’s Biggest Fantasy Creator Finally Confirms a Major Turning Point
content: It’s been a few months since Witch Hat Atelier concluded its first season, but the manga is still ongoing. Written and illustrated by Kamome Shirahima, the critically acclaimed manga began serialization in 2016.

title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement Has a Surprisingly Perfect Historical Element
content: Solo Leveling is expanding its franchise with a new anime movie, while other formats, such as K-dramas, are also being developed. However, the series has been on break for more than a year, so looking for something similar might be the best option for now.

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Creator Returns With New Debut & It’s Already a Smash Hit
content: Shueisha’s Shonen Jump magazine and platforms are famous for releasing all kinds of new series with unique stories and appealing casts. However, the competition has become increasingly difficult over the years, leading to several cancellations if those series don’t perform well.
